name: icloud-drive
description: Read and write your Apple iCloud Drive from Claude, with no synced Mac or PC folder.
long_description:
Gives Claude direct access to the files in your iCloud Drive — listing, reading, searching, writing, organising, and deleting them — by talking to Apple's iCloud service rather than a synced folder on disk. Everything runs locally on your own machine, so your Apple credentials never leave it and no server is involved.

Sign-in happens once through a page on your own computer, and needs your real Apple ID password plus a six-digit code from a trusted device. Apple does not accept app-specific passwords for iCloud Drive. The session then lasts around 30 days.

Deletes go to Recently Deleted rather than being destroyed, overwrites keep the previous version, and you can confine Claude to a single folder so nothing else in your Drive is reachable.

apple_id.title: Apple ID
apple_id.description: The email address of the Apple ID whose iCloud Drive you want Claude to use.

root_folder.title: Limit to folder
root_folder.description: Confine Claude to one folder, for example /Claude. Everything else in your Drive stays unreachable. Leave blank to allow the whole Drive.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Let Claude read your files but never write, move, or delete them.

max_file_mb.title: Largest file (MB)
max_file_mb.description: Refuse to read or write any single file bigger than this.

tools.name: icloud_list_directory
tools.description: List the folders and files inside one iCloud Drive folder.

tools.name: icloud_get_metadata
tools.description: Get type, size, and dates for one file or folder without downloading it.

tools.name: icloud_read_file
tools.description: Download one file and return its contents as text or base64.

tools.name: icloud_search
tools.description: Find files and folders by name under a starting folder.

tools.name: icloud_write_file
tools.description: Create or replace a file in iCloud Drive.

tools.name: icloud_create_directory
tools.description: Create a folder, optionally creating missing parents.

tools.name: icloud_move
tools.description: Move or rename a file or folder.

tools.name: icloud_delete
tools.description: Delete a file or folder, to Recently Deleted by default.

tools.name: icloud_session_status
tools.description: Report whether the iCloud connection is working.

tools.name: icloud_sign_in
tools.description: Open a sign-in page on this computer to connect or reconnect the Apple account.
